Service with a smile from all of the Front and back of house staff. Food was fresh and served incredibly quickly, queue moves quickly. Staff know what they are doing despite how busy and chaotic it seems !

•
It was extremely busy, with a constant line outside and the bar area tightly packed. We managed to squeeze in and grab a small space at the counter, which already felt like an achievement. Even the staff told us it was a quiet moment compared to their usual rush, which says a lot about how popular this place is.
•
The setup is very much organised chaos in the best possible way. There are only a few tables, and they are hard to get, so most people stand tightly packed at the bar while food is prepared and served at speed. Despite the pressure, everything runs with impressive efficiency.
•
We were lucky enough to try both the crispy suckling pig and their famous beef cheeks, just as they were running out. The beef cheeks were absolutely outstanding, rich, tender, and full of flavour. The crispy suckling pig was also excellent, perfectly textured and full of depth, adding another standout dish to the experience.
•
What stood out most is how the team manages such a fast, high-pressure environment with calm precision. It is hectic, but it works, and the food is genuinely amazing.
•
Definitely worth the effort and the wait.", "published": "4 months ago"}, {"author": "Jacek Lasota", "rating": 5, "text": "It is a really great place to eat great food. The point is that everyother dish I tried had a similar level: octopus, kokotxas, roasted pig ears, roasted piglet,...

To test it all you have two options: lineup to eat standing inside (faster, but always two crowded to enjoy it peacefully) or lineup for -o e out of 5- a sitted table at the backyard terrace (my recommendation).

Don't be afraid of the line : it is worth it!
